en: A black‑and‑white landscape view showing a broad grassy field in the foreground and, across a fence and tree line, a row of sizeable late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas or townhouses. Behind them is a wooded hillside. On the right, a well‑dressed man holding a cane stands beside a tree, raising his arm as if pointing or greeting someone. The buildings feature steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and one has a small spire or turret, giving the scene a Central European small‑town feel. There is no visible title or caption on the image side.
